title: Createve Store!!!!
description: The Created Store mod adds a store interface!
body: When you launch the mod, you'll need to create a Creative Store laptop to open the store interface. Your creation will appear as a photo in your gallery. The Created Store!!!! mod adds new items, mobs, weapons (both ranged and melee), and, of course, the store interface itself. Here's what it adds: two mobs: a turd and a gobnik; three types of weapons: a shovel-sword, a machine gun, a sniper rifle, and a pistol; ammunition: regular and sniper; banknotes for the store: rubles (MR) and kopecks (MT), which can be used to purchase items: vanilla and those added by the mod, and coins in rubles (MR) and kopecks (MT). This is an early version of the mod. There is also a bug with the item animations: the hands are in the wrong position. If you know how to fix this, please write to the Discord server. If you find any bugs, please report them to my Discord server. The update will be released on February 22, 2026.
